ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixels comprising approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) localized features providing a sharp contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-intensity pixel clusters located at the distal lateral tips; a group of parallel vertical linear high-intensity streaks in the superior quadrant of the left lobe; and isolated circular high-intensity nodes in the central-left medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate 85-degree vertex angle and a depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations (5-15 pixel deviations) concentrated at the lateral tips; low-amplitude, micro-serrations along the inner trailing edge leading toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature from the median notch extending towards the tips, terminating in an upward convex sweep at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two clearly visible circular high-intensity ring clusters (approx. 10-12 pixels in diameter) located in the medial-central region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of five distinct, parallel, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the upper left lobe, ranging from 40 to 90 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular high-intensity clusters at both lateral tips indicating heavy barnacle colonization; distinct rake-like parallel linear scarring on the left lobe.
